text: Buzz--Buzz--Buzz... Buzz--Buzz--Buzz--

It's already been so many years since we entered the age of smart technology, yet my mobile phone still hasn't learned that its owner gets sleepy in spring, dozes off in summer, and feels tired in autumn. Thus, it is vibrating wildly beside my pillow, making noises that interfere with my sleep.
After struggling with my drowsiness for a while, I wake up groggily and answer the phone call.
player
{character:player}Hello?
Nana Shiraishi
{character:Nana Shiraishi}Junior! Haven't you gotten up yet?
Nana Shiraishi's young and energetic voice coming from the other side is loud, clear, and very upbeat, so I pull my phone slightly farther away from my ear.
{character:player}Congratulations, you guessed correctly.
{character:Nana Shiraishi}Wow! It's already 6 a.m. How can you still sleep?
{character:player}It's ONLY 6 a.m.! Why are you awake already?!
{character:Nana Shiraishi}Because we need to prepare for the Nth pool party of Asaha High School.
{character:player}What number does "N" in "Nth" actually stand for?
{character:Nana Shiraishi}That's not important. The important thing is... Are you participating this time?
{character:player}The whole thing sounds sketchy to me... I don't believe the vice president would let you hold a pool party.
{character:Nana Shiraishi}Sigh, it's getting harder to trick you now...
{character:player}It's mainly because my awareness against scams is increasing year by year.
{character:Nana Shiraishi}Actually, the swimming club will be starting training tomorrow, and the swimming pool needs to be cleaned today.
{character:player}Suddenly, I don't know what I should comment on.
{character:Nana Shiraishi}You can comment on why I'm a substitute for all the clubs or comment on how you're the most enthusiastic citizen of One Han City.
{character:player}Geez, thank you for answering my question for me...

{character:Nana Shiraishi}You're welcome! So... you'll be coming right? I won't be the only one there. Hana, Yuzu, Liisa Liisa, and Kirara will also be there... Oh, that's right, Kana said she'll also make time to come...

{character:Nana Shiraishi}There's also... Hey, don't be in such a rush to hang up. I've already reported this matter to the vice president, and we've been given permission to play in the water freely. We can even have a water fight in the open-air swimming pool for the entire day!
{character:Nana Shiraishi}Oh... But you don't need to know how I reported it to the vice president, ahahahaha...

I would be lying if I said I wasn't moved by Nana Shiraishi's enthusiastic introduction. Through the phone, her youthful vigor is constantly calling for me to be free, but my desire to play fades away instantly when I remember what happened to Soul.
Sigh--I sure am the most enthusiastic citizen of One Han City.
{character:player}Sorry, Nana, I don't think I can come.
{character:Nana Shiraishi}You're amazing. You managed to turn me down decisively even after all the temptations I've been throwing at you.
{character:player}It isn't that I resisted the temptations... I promised someone yesterday to do something for them.
{character:Nana Shiraishi}What a shame... In that case, don't worry about it. I'll tell you how fun the party was after it ends!
{character:player}That won't be necessary...
"Beep--Beep--Beep--"
The busy tone that plays after a call is hung up starts playing before I can tell her no. Nana Shiraishi's hasty personality is something that I both love and hate.

After getting interrupted by her, I'm no longer in the mood to keep sleeping. After all, the key to going back to sleep is having nothing to worry about, and I'm now very worried about what I should say after meeting the leader of Strix.

I have returned to this dojo that looks very ordinary no matter how I look at it. The waiter from before is at the front desk, and he takes me to the office behind the secret passage. This place looks the same as when I came yesterday, and even the orientation of the legs has not changed in any way.
Noticing my presence, the other person gets up slowly and yawns before looking up at a nearby clock.
Kutsuji
{character:???}8:30?
{character:player}It's already 8:30. Are you still sleeping?
After I say this with complete confidence, I feel like my troubles have dissipated slightly, and I even straightened my back. This is probably the legendary "Nana Shiraishi effect."
{character:???}I... guess it's okay. Start early and finish early so you don't get in the way of me returning home to sleep.
{character:player}Don't tell me you're waiting here especially for me? What if I don't come?
{character:???}Based on my understanding of you, there's a 50% chance you'll come.
{character:player}What's there to understand? There are only two options, come and not come, so isn't it obvious that there's a 50% chance?
{character:???}That calculation is incorrect. You must know that Strix isn't known to be a charitable organization. Others aren't brave enough to come here alone like you.
{character:???}Oh, but I don't think you came here because you're brave. It's because you have absolutely no clue about what place this is. As they say, the ignorants are fearless.
Although my face is calm, turbulent waves surge through my heart. He is right.

All I know about Strix is that it's an organization that sells intelligence. I don't know anything about the scope of their business or their background. However, the best thing I can do now is to keep my silence and not make any comments because the other party can easily take control of the situation if I show any timidity at this moment.
Kutsuji smiles and doesn't really seem to care about my attitude. He walks out from behind the desk and leans against it, keeping a distance of about one meter from me.
{character:Kutsuji}If we're going to have a vendor and customer relationship from now on. Let me introduce myself to you, my new boss.
{character:Kutsuji}I'm Kutsuji, the leader of the intelligence organization Strix. As you can see, this is my office... well, one of them anyway.
{character:player}Although you already know about me, I'll introduce myself as well out of politeness.
{character:player}I'm {var:player_nickname}, and as you can see, I'm a Jyanshi who likes to play mahjong.
{character:Kutsuji}Well, I hope we get along during this transaction, {var:player_nickname}.
{character:Kutsuji}Of course, you're welcome to do business with us at any time after this transaction. As long as you have enough money, Strix can provide you with any information you need.
Wait! I feel like I've heard this line before many times. For example: "As long as you're rich enough, {var:player_nickname}, Luck and Fortune can even sell you good luck!"
Is this some kind of commercial phrase in One Han City? I won't be so easily deceived by this line anymore, so I choose to refuse.
{character:player}I haven't agreed to enter into a transaction with you yet.
{character:Kutsuji}That doesn't matter. I believe the chips in my hand will change your mind.
{character:Kutsuji}As far as I know, there's an animal tamer called Ciri in Soul who seems to be able to get inside Countless Springs quite often even though she doesn't make a lot of money.
{character:Kutsuji}What kind of place do you think Countless Springs is? Haha, it's famous in One Han City for being a money squandering establishment. Do you want to guess how she gets in?
{character:player}You... Don't imply strange things to me.
{character:Kutsuji}I'm just telling you what everyone sees and thinks.
{character:player}...Hmm.
{character:Kutsuji}Relax, I won't ask for an exorbitant sum. I just want you to do one thing for me. Complete this task, and I'll tell you what relationship Ciri has with Countless Springs.
I must admit that Kutsuji's offer is very enticing. He also hit the nail of the issue on the head, so I nod in agreement after thinking for a moment.
{character:Kutsuji}Oh? I haven't even told you what I want you to do yet. Don't you think you're agreeing too quickly?
{character:player}Hmm? Did you want me to reject your offer?
{character:Kutsuji}No, I'm just curious. Hasn't the thought that I might ask you to do something immoral, unethical, or illegal crossed your mind?
{character:player}Oh right...
Kutsuji's words are a reminder to me. Judging from our brief interaction, it's quite likely he might make such a request.
{character:player}You guys haven't always been doing immoral, unethical, or illegal things... right?
{character:Kutsuji}Are you trying to find out information about Strix? I'll need to charge you extra for that.
There's no way I will pay for that. Every copper I make as a Jyanshi must be used to make myself improve at the dojo. I pretend to zip up my mouth with my hand and don't ask any other questions.
{character:Kutsuji}Haha, you're an interesting person, and you even seem quite gullible.
{character:player}Um... Were you lying to me when you said you would give me the information I need?
{character:Kutsuji}No. I keep my word most of the time.

He taps the desk with his fingers as he speaks. Soon after, a person walks over from behind me. It is the girl who opened the door for me the other day. She hands me a very valuable-looking black bank card.
I look back on my brief interaction with Kutsuji in the past two days and decide that it isn't wise to agree to his request without knowing exactly what he wants me to do.
Noticing my hesitation, Kutsuji leans over me and smiles mockingly at me with raised eyebrows.
{character:Kutsuji}It looks like you don't trust me. I can assure you I won't ask you to do anything illegal.
{character:Kutsuji}I just want to test your courage. To me, it looks like you aren't that determined to help Soul.
{character:Kutsuji}Tsk. The information collected by my subordinates seems to be more inaccurate recently. They overestimated you.
{character:player}Are you trying to goad me into accepting?
He's definitely trying to goad me into agreeing. However, humans are strange creatures that will sometimes take the bait even if they know this.
It's because they know that the situation will go out of their control if they show weakness at this moment.

I reach out to wipe off some dust on his shoulder that appeared there when we weren't paying attention and look into his eyes without retreating. From this distance, I can even see a trace of surprise flash across his eyes.
{character:player}In that case... why don't you tell me the details of your request that doesn't involve anything illegal?

Kutsuji doesn't answer me directly. Instead, he taps the desk with his fingers as he speaks. Soon after, a person walks over from behind me. It is the girl who opened the door for me the other day. She hands me a very valuable-looking black bank card.
{character:Kutsuji}Take the funds you need for the task first.
{character:player}What funds?

{character:Kutsuji}Countless Springs holds an auction for cut flowers every month. They are auctioning off cut flowers on the surface, but the real thing that is being sold is the opportunity to have afternoon tea with the geisha behind each cut flower.

{character:Kutsuji}They are all beauties who people would spend a fortune to meet. Even Kurone Toujou takes part in this auction occasionally. All you have to do is get her flower and this opportunity.
{character:player}Which flower should I get?
{character:Kutsuji}I don't know.
{character:player}Huh?

{character:Kutsuji}This event has always been carried out in the form of a mystery draw. Every time it is held, each geisha picks their flower at the last minute based on their mood, so... you'll need to do your best.
A mystery draw... Those are bad in every circle! I recommend that all consumers boycott this practice!
{character:player}Isn't this pretty much a test of luck? Can't your intelligence network find a way to find out in advance?
{character:Kutsuji}We might be able to if it was anyone else but Kurone Toujou because only she knows which flower she will pick. She won't even tell the attendants closest to her.
{character:Kutsuji}All we know right now is that she will participate in tomorrow's auction.
{character:player}I thought people say there isn't any news you can't find out.
{character:Kutsuji}That's right. See? The mission you're about to do for us is to check out the news, right?
{character:player}I understand. So I need to attend this auction and win the bid for Kurone Toujou's flower, right?
{character:Kutsuji}To be precise, you need to attend the auction, win the bid for Kurone Toujou's flower, and meet her as the buyer.
{character:Kutsuji}After that, you will return here and tell me everything you saw and heard during this time.
{character:player}I have a question...
{character:player}Instead of running an errand for you, why do I feel like I'm getting some free benefits?
{character:player}Things like this that look and sound too good are usually...
{character:Kutsuji}Haha, it's always a pleasure to work with someone intelligent. Your witty reaction certainly proves why that gemstone dealer thinks so highly of you.
{character:player}The gemstone dealer you're talking about wouldn't happen to be... Saturne, right?

Saturne had told me before that businessmen like him have their own sources of information, such as the information brokers of One Han City who loiter in the back alleys of marketplaces but provide reliable information. Come to think of it, doesn't it sound like he was talking about Strix?
Fate is a mysterious thing.
{character:Kutsuji}It looks like Saturne has told you many things.

{character:Kutsuji}Sigh, it's not ethical to disclose information about other customers, but this sacrifice is necessary to win your trust. Since you know now, we can think of each other as a friend of a friend.
{character:Kutsuji}So you can relax. As a friend, I won't do anything to harm you. I won't even let you suffer any major material losses.
{character:player}To be precise, you're more like a business partner of a friend.
{character:Kutsuji}Haha, your mouth is like a fridge, and your remarks are all so cold.
{character:Kutsuji}Fine, in that case, please do a good job with this task for the sake of our mutual friend.
{character:Kutsuji}Oh, and remember to keep the content of this task secret.
{character:player}You can do this yourself, right? Why don't you get a member of Strix to do it instead?
{character:Kutsuji}If I can get someone else to run this errand for me, why waste the time of my own people?
{character:player}But your members should be more familiar with your line of business than me.
{character:Kutsuji}It looks like I'll need to make things explicit for you or else I won't be able to convince you.
{character:Kutsuji}Doing business is all about making friends. I want to be friends with Soul, but I'm sure they won't be able to pay the price I want to ask since that incident happened.
{character:Kutsuji}So for the sake of our friendship, the best solution is to use the labor of their representative, you, as collateral.

Kutsuji mentions something about an incident involving Soul that catches my attention. Judging from his attitude, this seems to be the main reason why Soul is currently suffering from financial difficulties. I also remember that Ciri mentioned a former member, a clown, who left Soul with a number of younger members.
I'm not sure if it is the same incident though... because I don't know much about this either.
{character:player}What is that incident about?
{character:Kutsuji}Tsk... They haven't told you even though you've been helping them for so long?
{character:Kutsuji}But you know, it's better not knowing some things. After all, if you know too much, it becomes harder to turn down some people's requests. I believe you've experienced this before.
{character:player}Indeed...
It's like how an NPC entices you to help them with rewards when they meet you for the first time. You might even get great rewards for just moving ten meters to pass on a message.
But after you learn more about what's happening, the NPC will say "you should do this since you already know about it" or "we should work together since you're already involved"...

After spending three to four hours to complete the quest, the rewards you end up with might not even be enough to draw one character. To get the characters you want, you really do need to spend money... Er, I got carried away. I pull back my thoughts and look at Kutsuji as sincerely as possible.
{character:player}It's not too late for you to tell me now.
{character:Kutsuji}You'll need to pay another price if you want that information.
As expected, sincerity means nothing when it comes to getting information from an information dealer.
{character:Kutsuji}Seriously, you're willing to help those people of Soul run errands even though you don't know anything. Are you someone who counts money for those who betray you and sell you off?
Soul won't do that to me, but I can't say the same about Strix. I look down at the black card in my hand and then look at him again.
{character:Kutsuji}Tsk, are you doubting me? *Sigh*... don't worry, I don't have plans to sell you off yet. I mean, I don't even know what price I can get.
{character:Kutsuji}Why don't you do your best to complete this task to prove yourself so I can estimate your worth?

I feel like talking to this person is the best cure for hypotension. I've already lost track of how many times I've sighed today, and I sigh again before I decide to get the conversation back on track.
{character:player}Let's get down to business. Does this card have a password?
{character:Kutsuji}Yes, it is "KutsujiTheHandsome."
My gut feeling tells me I shouldn't believe that. Besides, bank cards issued by the banks of One Han City should only be a combination of 6 digits. How can it be a phrase?
{character:player}Er... Do you expect me to believe that?
{character:Kutsuji}It looks like you weren't fooled. I feel better now. With your level of vigilance, you should be able to handle Kurone Toujou alone without getting eaten alive.
{character:player}Since you're worried I can't handle Kurone Toujou alone, why don't you consider preparing something for me to memorize and say to her?
{character:Kutsuji}Haha, you sure are interesting. The tea party can last for several hours, and you don't know what unexpected things will happen while you're there. How can you prepare for that?
{character:player}Good point. Maybe you can give me more information about Kurone Toujou so I don't make any mistakes.
{character:Kutsuji}What I want is for you to make mistakes.
{character:player}Huh?
{character:Kutsuji}It's because it's the easiest to win someone's trust with authentic reactions.

{character:Kutsuji}In the eyes of an intelligent person, even a perfect performance has tell-tale traces. Even an international movie star like Cohen won't be able to put up a perfect performance in front of Kurone Toujou, let alone you.
{character:player}In that case, how will I know if I've completed this task successfully?
{character:Kutsuji}That depends on how many pieces of useful information you can bring back.
{character:player}Useful information?

{character:Kutsuji}For example, everyone knows Kurone Toujou is one of the Four Greats, so that info is worthless. However, if you're able to get Kurone Toujou to tell you the exact date of the next mahjong competition held by the Mahjong Soul Shrine, then that information counts as useful information.

{character:Kutsuji}Relax, the information network of Strix will verify the authenticity of the information. You just need to follow your heart and chat with Kurone Toujou about topics you're interested in.
{character:player}Although I understand everything you said separately, it sounds strange to me when I string them all together. I'll just do my best.
{character:player}I have another question. Our discussion so far is based on the premise that I'll definitely be able to meet Kurone Toujou. What if... I don't manage to meet her?
{character:Kutsuji}What if... That would be another story then, and we can talk about that later.

Kutsuji just smiles. I can't figure out what he wants, and I even get the feeling that he doesn't really care whether I manage to meet Kurone Toujou or not. I don't know if he has ulterior motives for asking me to do this task, but it seems like I don't have any better options right now.

Kutsuji reaches out and takes my phone, then he taps it many times quickly. When he returns it to me, I see that a string of numbers that looks like a phone number has been added to the Contacts screen, and the name of the contact is "Kutsuji the Handsome."
My earlier evaluation of him was that he is a little mean and petty, has poor sitting posture, and does not have a great temper... Now I need to add one more thing to the list: he is narcissistic.
{character:Kutsuji}Oh right. The real password of that card is your birthday.
If that's the case, why do you need me to do this?
{character:player}If that's the case, why do you need me to do this?
{character:player}I've never been to Countless Springs. Upon deeper thought, I don't have expertise in any particular field either... and nor do I know magic or have superpowers.
{character:player}I don't have money to develop amazing technology to use, and I'm not a mutant either.
Kutsuji looks at me and nods like he is agreeing with me.
{character:Kutsuji}That's true, but you shouldn't put yourself down that much even though you are quite an ordinary person.
{character:player}Geez, thank you for those words of affirmation...

{character:Kutsuji}However... others might see things differently. Everyone in One Han City, from the Four Greats of the city to elementary school students, can become friends with you. This kind of relationship network is desirable to all information dealers.
{character:player}It's because I'm a good person.
{character:Kutsuji}I won't dispute that. According to our investigations, you really are an ordinary good citizen of One Han City who has no criminal records.
{character:player}I don't think I can explain this in a way you can understand, but all citizens have the duty to follow the law.
{character:Kutsuji}Look, you're insinuating that I don't follow the law again. If you conduct your own investigations, you'll find that I don't have any criminal records either.

{character:Kutsuji}To be honest though, there is something you can do that ordinary people can't. You can enter the Mahjong Soul Shrine freely, and you're the only one in One Han City whom that mysterious priestess will call master.

{character:player}Wait a minute, you make a good point in the second part of your sentence, but isn't everyone able to enter the Mahjong Soul Shrine freely? Isn't the Mahjong Soul Shrine nicknamed the "free celestial dojo?"

{character:Kutsuji}They can only access the outermost facilities of the Mahjong Soul Shrine. If you look at the size of the shrine, you'll notice that a rather large area behind it is not open to the public.
{character:Kutsuji}According to our speculations, you should be able to enter that area.
{character:player}Don't arouse people's curiosity so casually. You might be killed by a cat if you're too curious at the Mahjong Soul Shrine.
{character:Kutsuji}I only want to share this news with you. Whether you go or not is up to you.
{character:Kutsuji}Of course, you're welcome to seek me out at any time if you want to do business with me after visiting that area.
{character:player}So is this the reason why you chose me?

{character:Kutsuji}Would you believe me if I said yes? After all, it shouldn't be too difficult for someone who can access the most mysterious place of the Mahjong Soul Shrine to get close to Kurone Toujou.
{character:Kutsuji}You can think of it as a gamble. I'm gambling that you can get through the air-tight protective boxes around Kurone Toujou.
{character:player}It isn't really a gamble. You won't suffer any losses even if I can't complete the task.
{character:Kutsuji}Of course I will suffer losses. I worked hard to earn that money copper by copper.

As he speaks, he reaches out and takes my phone, then he taps it many times quickly. When he returns it to me, I see that a string of numbers that looks like a phone number has been added to the Contacts screen, and the name of the contact is "Kutsuji the Handsome."

Although I still have doubts about the authenticity of the password, surely no one will play a prank in work-related matters, right? To ensure I don't forget the password tomorrow, I conscientiously create a note on my mobile phone and write down the password.
Kutsuji stares at me for a while, then he sighs.
{character:Kutsuji}You're such an honest person.
{character:Kutsuji}Now even I'm starting to worry that tomorrow's task will end in failure. After all, your opponents will be experienced and clever people.
{character:player}Do you have a solution then? Something like a plan B.
{character:Kutsuji}It's a pity, but there's only a plan A for this task.
{character:player}Hmm... How will I know if I've completed this task successfully?
{character:Kutsuji}Hmm, let's just say that whether it is successful or not depends on how many pieces of useful information you can bring back.
{character:player}I have another question. The success of the task is based on the premise that I'll definitely be able to meet Kurone Toujou. What if... I don't manage to meet her?
{character:Kutsuji}What if... That would be another story then. After all, we don't have a plan B, right?
However, when he sees the screen of my mobile phone, he reaches out to take my phone and looks at me with disgust.
{character:Kutsuji}Everyone knows that I'm handsome. Do you really need to make a note to remember that?

{character:player}I'm afraid that if I memorize this phrase, certain aspects of myself, such as my appearance, figure, social etiquette, beautiful morals, beautiful character, and soul will be ruined.

Kutsuji sneers and then quickly deletes the note I just entered. After that, he opens my Contacts on my mobile phone and enters a string of numbers that looks like a phone number and writes "Kutsuji The Handsome" as the name of the contact.
{character:player}You... Don't tell me you use this password for all your accounts?
{character:Kutsuji}Haha, no way! This password is obviously fake. I can't believe someone would actually think it's real.
{character:Kutsuji}So you don't need to worry about forgetting it because the real password is your birthday.
{character:Kutsuji}That's true, but you shouldn't put yourself down that much, even though you are just an ordinary person.

Kutsuji looks all over me while talking. Suddenly, his eyes freeze on the screen of my mobile phone. I forgot to lock the screen after noting down the password just now. He reaches out to take my phone and looks at me with disgust after taking a closer look at the content displayed on the screen.

{character:player}Well... I'm afraid that if I memorize this phrase, certain aspects of myself, such as my appearance, figure, social etiquette, beautiful morals, beautiful character, and soul will be ruined.
If this was a love movie, I might think this is a romantic plot.
If this is a movie about friendship, I would even risk my life to help my friend.

But this person is someone I have just met... well, someone I am only meeting for the second time. Our relationship isn't close enough for us to share this information, which makes me want to stab him instead.
{character:player}How can you invade my privacy like that?!
How can you invade my privacy like that?!
{character:Kutsuji}Isn't this very normal? An information dealer must know themselves and their customers well. Not only do I know your birthday, but I even know...
As he speaks, he moves closer to me and lowers his voice.
{character:Kutsuji}I know you have a very interesting favorites folder. I don't mind if you share its contents with me, such as...
Before he can say anything, I stuff his bank card in his face and look quickly around me.

Other than the girl who gave me the bank card earlier, who is now quietly playing with her mobile phone, there are two people standing like statues nearby in a corner. They ignore everything we are doing completely, and I don't think they will do anything to me unless I pull out some kind of weapon and attack Kutsuji.
{character:Kutsuji}Blergh! I like money, but that doesn't mean you can put just anything in my mouth.
{character:Kutsuji}Don't worry, I'm an information dealer who has principles. I won't disclose your information to anyone lightly... unless they pay a good price for it.
{character:player}Do you even hear what you're saying?

{character:Kutsuji}Of course, I can keep your information completely confidential too. We'll become friends eventually if you help me out often, and I'll keep all your information confidential because of our friendship.
{character:player}A friendship obtained by making threats won't last very long...
{character:player}How did you find out my birthday?
How did you find out my birthday?

Kutsuji doesn't answer, but instead glances at me and sighs. He takes out his mobile phone and taps it a few times before handing it to me. On the screen is my CatChat homepage. After I tap my profile picture on the screen and go to my profile, I see my birthday information in a very conspicuous place, along with some memories of things that happened not too long ago.
CatChat is a social media software that requires real-name authentication. It's most likely that I didn't enable the option to hide my real information, which is why it is shown on my homepage.
{character:player}I made a mistake. I knew I should have hidden it...

{character:Kutsuji}In the era of big data, there are many ways to find out this type of personal information that is entered on the Internet. Instead of hiding it, you should try not to casually enter your personal information on various websites unless you really have to in the future.
{character:player}I suddenly feel like I'm in a class about cybersecurity. However, something doesn't feel right about these words coming from your mouth.

{character:Kutsuji}You're being too cautious with me. What about this? We'll become friends over time if you help me out often, then you can trust me and I can keep your information confidential. Wouldn't we both win then?
{character:player}No, I think I'll be the only one who will get hurt in that scenario.
{character:player}Forget it, I'll just let this matter drop. Let's talk about what will happen during tomorrow's task instead.
{character:Kutsuji}You don't need to worry about that. I'll get Noah to go with you because she knows a lot about these things.

I look in the direction he is motioning. It turns out that the girl who handed the card to me earlier is called Noah. As if she heard Kutsuji calling her name, she raises her head and glances at us before she nods and continues playing with her mobile phone.
{character:Kutsuji}Although Noah doesn't like to talk, she is a core member of Strix, and you can trust her abilities fully.
{character:player}*Sigh*... None of the children of One Han City can be judged by their appearances. Their abilities have nothing to do with their age...
{character:Kutsuji}After all, not everyone is lucky enough to be able to grow up sheltered like a flower protected inside a greenhouse.

While I'm leaving, instead of calling the waiter over, Kutsuji decides to see me out himself. There is actually a hidden door in one of the walls of this office, and it's really hard to find it unless you look carefully.
Kutsuji opens the secret door, revealing a room with exactly the same layout as the room I'm in, and even the location of the secret door is the same.

After passing through three identical rooms that remind me of nesting dolls, I am greeted by sunlight coming in through glass windows and not the light of lightbulbs. I realize that we are now in an elegantly furnished flower shop.

Various flowers are placed neatly inside the shop, and two or three customers are choosing flowers they like to make into a pleasing bouquet after listening to the employees' explanations. Compared with other industries, this shop is very quiet and comfortable, and no one pays any attention to us who have just walked out of a door with the words "fire exit" written next to it.
After exiting the flower shop, I find myself facing a commercial strip that is bustling with activity as people come and go. Suddenly, I feel a little emotional.
{character:player}The spy movies are true.

{character:player}Oh.
{character:Kutsuji}You shouldn't watch so many movies in the future.

I decide not to argue with him since he personally saw me out and explained so many things to me. When I turn to leave, Kutsuji calls out to stop me. I look back and see him standing under the sun with a vitality unique to men around his age, but cold words come out of his mouth...
{character:Kutsuji}You're leaving just like this. Aren't you worried about the compensation you'll need to pay if you fail tomorrow's task?

{character:Kutsuji}Things are very expensive at Countless Springs. If you mess up the task tomorrow, should I make you bear the cost of tomorrow's expenses, such as the ticket fee and everything else?
The more shameless a person is, the more invincible they are.
I look up at the sky and note that it's not that late yet...
I let out a long breath and remind myself that a good citizen of One Han City should never lose their temper before I turn around to look at him.

{character:player}...I can only keep up my manners for another thirty seconds at most.

{character:player}After all, this task relies too much on luck, and it isn't worth it if I end up bearing a huge debt because of this.

{character:Kutsuji}No, you know too many secrets now. Don't you think it's too late for you to back out now? Strix is a place where everyone earns their keep.

{character:player}I... I'll do my best then.

With Kutsuji smiling brightly at me, I turn around and walk home with heavy steps, feeling like I've hit rock bottom emotionally.

The time I spent talking to him in his office wasn't a complete waste of time as I've pretty much figured out what Kutsuji's personality is like. In a nutshell, he derives pleasure from another person's misfortune and suffering.

{character:Kutsuji}You're starting to look the part now. I think I really don't need to worry about tomorrow now.

From his laughter behind me, I can feel that he really is in a good mood. I hope tomorrow's task will go well.

After leaving Strix, I search for information about Countless Springs on the Internet and find out that it is an okiya for high-end geisha, as well as the place where Kurone Toujou of the Four Greats lives. The song and dance performances held there are all superb, and the geisha there might not be willing to meet you no matter how much money you offer them.

That's especially true in the case of Kurone Toujou who runs the place. However, it's been years since she has played the shamisen, and I hear that her music is absolutely delightful. Unfortunately, no one gets to enjoy her music now.

A message in the comments section catches my attention. "If you want to meet Kurone Toujou at Countless Springs, you might as well go to the dojo she runs. Maybe she will even teach you some mahjong skills."
